title: North America Accessories monthly sales and quantity
description: Backend-neutral article scenario: North America Accessories monthly sales and quantity. The same scenario must be executed through sql_direct and xmla_emondrian.
block_theme: Bikes instead of Accessories, customer phone, wrong grain

queries.label: AW Q1 — ALLOW SalesAmount by month and territory
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])
